Package com.privatechain.crypto

Class HashUtil

java.lang.Object
com.privatechain.crypto.HashUtil
public final class HashUtil extends Object
Utility class providing cryptographic hash functions used throughout the blockchain.

All methods return lowercase hexadecimal strings. BouncyCastle is registered lazily on first use so that the JVM does not pay the registration cost when the class is loaded but no hash is computed (FR-CRYPTO-01 – FR-CRYPTO-03).

Supported algorithms

  • sha256(String) / sha256(byte[]) — NIST SHA-256
  • sha3_256(String) / sha3_256(byte[]) — Keccak / NIST SHA-3-256
  • doubleSha256(String) / doubleSha256(byte[]) — SHA-256(SHA-256(x)), the double-hash used in Bitcoin-style block and transaction IDs

Thread safety

All methods create fresh MessageDigest instances for each call so they are safe to use from multiple threads simultaneously. 

 String blockHash = HashUtil.sha256("index|prevHash|merkleRoot|timestamp");
 String txId      = HashUtil.doubleSha256(rawBytes);
Since:
1.0.0
